system.description:
When failure threatens, you throw everything you have at the Skill Challenge to prevent disaster.

Effect: Once per Skill Challenge, when you or an ally accrues a third Failure (Which would normally end the Skill Challenge), you or the ally can reroll the attempt, keeping the better result.

Special: This Feat is allowed only in campaigns that use Skill Challenges.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Galaxy of Intrigue
